intro: Available for consulting, freelance projects, and full-time opportunities worldwide.

services.title: Legged & Physical-AI Robotics
services.description: Gait and locomotion control, RL policies, and sim-to-real for quadrupeds and humanoids — in MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or on your hardware.

services.title: ROS 2 Simulation & Navigation
services.description: Gazebo / Isaac Sim worlds, Nav2 stacks, SLAM, and the sim-to-real pipeline that gets your robot navigating reliably — validated before hardware.

services.title: Full-Stack Robot Development
services.description: Mechanical design + embedded (STM32 / Jetson) + control, taken from an idea or a stalled prototype to a tested, documented, deployed system.

services.title: Robotics R&D & Technical Consulting
services.description: Architecture reviews, technology selection, proof-of-concept builds, and IEEE-standard documentation — backed by published research.

process.title: Understand
process.description: Deep-dive into your requirements, constraints, and goals — so we build the right thing from day one.

process.title: Design
process.description: CAD models, simulations, and system architecture validated before a single part is ordered or a line of code is written.

process.title: Build & Test
process.description: Iterative prototyping with regular progress updates — you stay informed at every milestone.

process.title: Deliver
process.description: Fully documented, tested deliverable handed over cleanly — with post-delivery support included.
